correctness.rationale: For any complete multipartite graph D is TRD iff it meets at least two classes and its complement is empty or meets at least two. r>=4 has two untouched classes after selecting a cross-part pair; r=3,N>=4 has a non-singleton class and a partner for each singleton. K3 and K1,m (m>=2) admit only the whole graph as TRD and thus exactly two coalition blocks; K2 has two, and Kp,q with p,q>=2 has the singleton partition. No graph with N vertices admits more than N partition blocks.
